name: token-budget
description: Shows the session's token spend (main conversation, subagents and compactions) against a budget from the budget setting or OMC_RUN_BUDGET_TOKENS, in a band above the prompt: a warning from 90%, an alert from 100%. Display only; hidden when no budget is set.

budget.title: Token budget
budget.description: Tokens this session may spend before the band turns to an alert; at least 1. 0 uses OMC_RUN_BUDGET_TOKENS instead; when both are set, this value wins. Any other value is ignored with a one-time notice.
